BiblicalUsage: A brier is a prickling thorn, and God tells Ezekiel not to fear the briers and thorns among whom he must speak. The house of Israel will no longer be a pricking brier to God's people, and the word carries the sting with it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God warns His prophets about the briers because He knows the work will hurt, and He sends them anyway.
